shots.content: Inside a game room, a rectangular board-game table stands between a shelving unit and the doorway, with a window along one side. A woman in an emerald sweater at the shelf-side window seat recounts a recent misadventure, beside a man in a maroon hoodie at the doorway-side window seat and a woman in a navy cardigan at the shelf-end seat.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from the doorway end, looking lengthwise along the game table toward the shelving unit, with both window-side seats and the shelf-end seat in frame.

shots.content: The man in the maroon hoodie asks the woman in the emerald sweater about the outcome.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the aisle side, centered on the two adjacent window-side seats.

shots.content: The woman in the emerald sweater explains how the situation concluded to the man in the maroon hoodie.
shots.viewpoint: Reverse wide shot from the shelving-unit end, looking lengthwise along the game table toward the doorway, with both window-side seats and the shelf-end seat in frame.
